cc_updates.body: Added session tracking headers and VCS exclusions. Fixed --resume failures, file access issues outside project root, config disk writes, /feedback crashes, and plugin script permissions on macOS/Linux. Enhanced prompt caching, improved performance across multiple areas including startup and token overhead reduction.

Extended MCP environment variables and added conditional hook filtering. Improved deep link support and RFC 9728 OAuth compliance. Fixed plugin management, multi-monitor issues, authorization flows, and memory leaks. Enhanced file autocomplete performance and improved scroll functionality with TypeScript layout implementation.

Introduced PowerShell tool for Windows preview. Added environment variables for model capability overrides and configurable streaming timeouts. Implemented transcript search and enhanced keybindings. Fixed voice push-to-talk issues, workflow subagents, and improved various terminal behaviors including cursor tracking for IME.

Added managed settings drop-in directory and hook events for environment tracking. Introduced transcript search functionality and external editor binding. Fixed mouse tracking leaks, diffing hangs, voice input delays, and MCP cache issues. Improved startup performance and Remote Control session handling.

Introduced --bare flag for scripted calls and --channels permission relay research preview. Fixed concurrent session authentication, voice WebSocket failures, and tool streaming through proxies. Improved background agent handling and plugin caching. Enhanced MCP tool descriptions and remote session titles.

Added rate limit status display and inline plugin marketplace sourcing. Implemented effort frontmatter for skills and improved file autocomplete performance. Fixed --resume parallel tool drops, voice authentication issues, and managed settings application at startup. Enhanced responsiveness and memory usage.

Added Console authentication and turn duration toggle. Fixed -p mode hanging and Ctrl+C handling. Improved voice activation and command invocation reliability. Enhanced tab navigation and enterprise rate limit retry. Added AI-generated session titles in VS Code with improved startup memory usage.

Added StopFailure hook and persistent plugin state directory. Enabled line-by-line response streaming. Fixed sandbox issues on Linux, permission rule enforcement, and file I/O problems. Improved Bash tool PATH resolution and implemented security fixes for sandbox disable scenarios.

Increased output token limits for Opus 4.6 to 64k and upper bounds to 128k. Added sandbox read allowlists and /copy indexing. Fixed auto-updater overlaps, --resume truncation, and hook permission bypass issues. Enhanced startup performance and improved various UI elements across terminals.

Implemented MCP elicitation support with interactive dialogs. Added -n name flag, worktree sparse checkout, and /effort command. Fixed deferred tool schemas, plan re-approval, and voice mode issues. Improved worktree startup performance and background agent behavior with enhanced session titles.
